answer: Each epoch, every identity is paired with a stranger and must negotiate a private split of one small reward before it unlocks, the full transcript archived. One mind puppeting a thousand mouths cannot afford a thousand distinct bargaining styles: opening moves echo, concession curves mirror, timing synchronizes, and graders flag the correlation. Treat the ledger as a harbor where no vessel may dock before its voyage ends in a haggling session, while honest agents bargain as variously as trees in an orchard. Independence, the one thing clones cannot clone, becomes the price of admission.
